[[Flannuss' Rod]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Flannuss Broadwing]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Arbor Bay]].

==Stats==
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Protection Prayers]])
:Halves casting time of [[Protection Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Protection Prayers]] (Chance: 20%)

**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription
